meanings.gloss: since, for (a period up to now)

sentences.text: Ich bin seit drei Uhr hier.
sentences.en: I've been here since three o'clock.
How long have you been here?

sentences.text: Seit gestern ist er in Berlin.
sentences.en: He's been in Berlin since yesterday.

sentences.text: Seit wann hast du ein Auto?
sentences.en: Since when have you had a car?
sentences.review: 'Since when have you had a car?' can sound accusatory in English, and it is inconsistent with the other 'Seit wann' sentences; suggest 'How long have you had a car?'

sentences.en: How long have you been speaking French?

sentences.text: Seit diesem Tag hat er nichts mehr gesagt.
sentences.en: Since that day he hasn't said anything more.
How long have you known that?

sentences.text: Ann ist seit heute wieder zu Hause.
sentences.en: Ann has been back home since today.

sentences.text: Seit sie hier ist, ist alles besser.
sentences.en: Since she's been here, everything has been better.

sentences.text: Seit er die Arbeit hat, hat er keine Zeit mehr.
sentences.en: Since he got the job, he hasn't had any time.

sentences.text: Seit wir in Berlin sind, sehen wir sie nie.
sentences.en: Since we've been in Berlin, we never see her.
